g.text: BC-05 Inventory Availability — Tactical Domain Model (TARGET / V1)
InventoryReservation protects demand; WarehouseBacking distributes it by SKU + Warehouse.
Sellable Availability = max(0, on-hand - held - reserved - safety stock).
`reserved` is the InventoryReservation projection; WarehouseBacking is not a second subtraction.
FEFO is a policy over lot expiry; no cross-BC FK is implied.
